items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions 'Lucky Melander's Blue Rhythm Band' and the interviewee does not claim a personal connection, only acknowledging the timeline.

ctx.x: I was just wondering, I used to hear the Lucky Melander's Blue Rhythm Band, that was probably after that time. After that time, yeah. You hear him up in the Apollo Theater and all the other people, the Harlem Opera House a lot. So I guess your brother was dead then by that time. I don't think I heard him until about 1935 or 1936, along in the Depression, I know. I might have heard him before, but not.
But he had stopped playing before that. Well, he stopped.
